# loc-yiddish-mixedscript

A Liberty Loan advertisement in Hebrew-script Yiddish: a right-to-left headline and body with Latin numerals and dates set inline, over a three-column Latin list of ninety bank names. We ship an eng model only, so this records what the reader DOES with a script it cannot read.
